mechanism.claim: When BVOL and DVOL are already elevated, a large completed-hour BTC move accompanied by an unusually large contraction in perpetual open interest marks forced inventory removal rather than new-position chasing; the liquidation-driven price direction should continue for six hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the completed-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVOPCR requires falling OI, high cross-venue implied-volatility levels, and price continuation. OCDR and OICER required rising OI and traded reversal; CVLIR used absolute OI repricing, opposite volatility bodies, and a late-half breakout.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: dual implied-volatility levels plus causal perpetual-OI purge and completed-hour price shock are absent from Gross9

clock.decision: T after one completed UTC hour [T-1h,T)
clock.volatile_regime: BVOL close and DVOL close at T are each >= own strictly-prior 720h q60, requiring 672 valid observations
clock.oi: raw-time backward-asof positive BTCUSDT OI observations at T and T-60m, each age<=5m; change=current/prior-1 must be strictly negative
clock.oi_purge: absolute one-hour OI change >= strictly-prior 720h q75 with 672 observations
clock.price_shock: nonzero absolute completed-hour BTC return >= strictly-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset on an exact consecutive valid hourly grid
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open after every signal feature is available
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.completed_price_hour: reuse hash-bound OICER completed-hour snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
